decks.notes: The core idea of this deck is to quickly generate a large amount of mana through spells like Desperate Ritual and Seething Song, in order to cast powerful combo cards such as Big Score and Crossover Collaboration. The use of Thornscape Familiar and Goblin Anarchomancer helps reduce the cost of spells, while cards like Electric Revelation and Glimpse the Impossible provide card advantage and dig for key pieces of the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and explosive combo play, utilizing the red and green color combination to their fullest potential.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with a variety of Elves and use their abilities to generate large amounts of mana. With cards like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania, the deck aims to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful threats such as Nyxborn Hydra and Timberwatch Elf. Winding Way and Lead the Stampede help to dig through the deck and find more Elves to further overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes efficient removal options like Masked Vandal and Avenging Hunter to maintain board control.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around Elves. By utilizing cards like Avenging Hunter, Timberwatch Elf, and Priest of Titania, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and pump up its creatures to deal massive damage. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help to refill the hand with more Elves, while Masked Vandal provides some flexibility for dealing with threats. Overall, the deck is geared towards quickly building a strong board and overwhelming the opponent with relentless attacks.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth to power out big creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. It also includes land destruction spells like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and disrupt their mana base, allowing the Gruul player to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to create a fast and aggressive strategy, taking advantage of cards like Refurbished Familiar and Myr Enforcer to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board with efficient creatures and removal spells, while also drawing cards with Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Makeshift Munitions and Torch the Tower provides additional reach to finish off opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creature removal while utilizing artifacts and lands to generate card advantage and maintain board control. The deck focuses on utilizing cheap removal spells like Cast Down and Krark-Clan Shaman to control the board and keep the opponent on the defensive. It also includes cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Ichor Wellspring to disrupt graveyard strategies and draw extra cards. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence to close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of direct damage spells and aggressive creature attacks. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Fireblast, and Fiery Temper, along with creatures like Guttersnipe and Kessig Flamebreather, the goal is to burn the opponent's life total down as fast as possible. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and additional burn spells to maintain a consistent offensive strategy throughout the game.

This Mono Blue Aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cheap spells like Thought Scour and Mental Note to power up Cryptic Serpent and Tolarian Terror. By combining aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Dispel, the deck aims to control the early game and push through damage. Lórien Revealed is used to generate card advantage, while Sleep of the Dead provides a finisher against slower decks. Overall, this deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of removal spells, card draw, and mana acceleration. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources. The Golgari / Jund color combination allows for flexibility in dealing with various threats. The key strategy is to maintain board presence and card advantage while slowly wearing down the opponent's defenses. The deck is designed to outlast opponents and grind out a victory through attrition.

This Mono Blue Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap, evasive creatures like Brinebarrow Intruder and Faerie Miscreant to quickly pressure opponents. By leveraging counterspells like Spellstutter Sprite and disruption like Snap, the deck aims to maintain tempo and control the battlefield. With card draw spells like Of One Mind and Ninja of the Deep Hours, the deck can maintain card advantage and outpace opponents. The inclusion of Moon-Circuit Hacker allows for additional card draw and recursion, while Harrier Strix provides added flying pressure. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with speed and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing Tireless Tribe as a core combo piece, supported by cards like Inside Out and Pursue the Past to pump up Tireless Tribe's power and toughness to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. The deck also contains a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and creatures like Aurora Eidolon and Sandstorm Eidolon to control the board and protect the combo. The inclusion of cards like Faithless Looting and Thrilling Discovery helps with card draw and selection, ensuring the deck can consistently assemble the combo pieces needed to win.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth to cast powerful creatures and disruptive spells earlier than usual. Cards like Avenging Hunter, Boarding Party, and Annoyed Altisaur help apply pressure to the opponent while Eldrazi Repurposer and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss disrupt their mana base. Malevolent Rumble can provide additional creature removal or reach for the final points of damage. The aim is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and mana advantage.

The deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Ephemerate and Mulldrifter. It aims to control the board with counterspells and removal spells like Skred, while also utilizing flicker effects to generate card advantage and protect key creatures. The deck can also transition into a more aggressive strategy with burn spells like Cast into the Fire and Fanged Flames if needed. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient and effective control tactics.

The main idea of this deck is to use efficient and low-cost creatures to deal damage quickly to the opponent, while also disrupting their mana base with land destruction spells. By ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, the deck can cast larger threats like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter early in the game. Writhing Chrysalis and Eldrazi Repurposer provide additional value by creating tokens or removing opponent's creatures. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast aggression and resource disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to play fast and efficiently, utilizing cards like Burning-Tree Emissary and Goblin Bushwhacker to quickly build a board presence. Chain Lightning and Galvanic Blast provide additional reach to finish off the opponent, while cards like Goblin Tomb Raider and Clockwork Percussionist offer additional creature support. The goal is to apply constant pressure and close out the game quickly before the opponent has time to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards like Counterspell, Dispel, and Ephemerate to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage with cards like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas. The deck also focuses on tempo plays with cards like Fanged Flames and Murmuring Mystic, and mana efficiency with cards like Skred and Perilous Landscape. The deck also has a strong mana base with Snow-Covered lands and synergies with Lórien Revealed and Union of the Third Path to gain incremental advantages over the opponent.
